correctness.rationale: Exact arch criterion is reconstructed (including an explicit missing subsequence). At each active seen-cardinality s>=d, all last d letters are already seen, so precisely s-d of q-d allowed symbols repeat and q-s are fresh. This proves B_r, H_r and the renewal equation as formal series. Minimality uses per-symbol multiplicity and counts compatible permutation blocks. Conditioned uniform choices produce independent geometric stages and ordinary renewal SLLN/CLT with explicit finite moments. A standalone stdlib verifier compared formal-series coefficients, weighted-state enumeration and literal word checks for q<=8, d>=2, plus extremal and exceptional cases. Risks: unbounded proof is analytic/combinatorial, not formally machine certified; all random asymptotics require fixed parameters.

value.rationale: Proper colorings of powers of paths are a standard natural finite-language family. For the whole two-parameter range 2<=d<q, the theorem evaluates the entire joint length-index series, exact optimal counts, the attainable-domain dichotomy, and an explicit renewal speed/variance with a deterministic-to-Gaussian boundary. The all-radius scalar-state invariant is not a tiny numerical gain or arbitrary slice; it explains the structural behavior and supports constrained sequence design.
